heading: Rule 9 — `dynamic_ttl: true` under `realtime` and `linear_scan: false`
text:
### Rule 9 — `dynamic_ttl: true` under `realtime` and `linear_scan: false` [LCAP.3.9]

Under `realtime` with `linear_scan: false`, every term of T_wcet but the TTL
tick is O(1) in N_max ([LCAP.5]). With `dynamic_ttl: true` the tick is
O(expired × log N_ttl) ([LCAP.3.3]), so the T_wcet formula is no longer O(1) in
N_max. The compiler should warn of a program with all three settings. The
warning has no `DS_VALIDATE_*` code, and a compiler emits only registered codes
([RCLI.5.1]), so the edition that admits `realtime` allocates one with it.
